title: Local pilot fixture: configure retry duration
description: This is an offline integration fixture, not a real GitHub PR. The delay_ms function must return the delay in milliseconds. Input seconds is a nonnegative integer, so delay_ms(2) must return 2000. Rename the parameter for clarity without changing behavior.

files.patch:
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
-def delay_ms(s):
-    return s * 1000
+def delay_ms(seconds):
+    return seconds * 1000
